1.question: What makes Òrbita different from other DJ/event providers?
1.answer: We create complete personalized experiences. Not just music: theming + animation + music adapted in real time + games + effects. Our DJ reads the environment and adapts on the fly. We adapt every detail to your vision. We don't sell equipment, we design the exact experience you imagine.

2.question: How much does it cost to hire Òrbita for my wedding/party/event?
2.answer: We work with clear packs and configurators according to needs. Prices are calculated automatically based on schedule, equipment and type of event. You can see all the options in the configurator or request a personalized quote through our form and we will respond to you in less than 2 hours.

3.question: Do you work outside of Barcelona? Do you cover Girona and the Costa Brava?
3.answer: Yes, we cover the province of Barcelona and the province of Girona (including the Costa Brava). FREE transport up to 25 km from Granollers (our base). Beyond, it is added according to the distance. We have done events in Barcelona, ​​Granollers, Mataró, Sabadell, Terrassa, Vic, Girona, Figueres, Blanes, Lloret... If it is in our area, we will go.

4.question: What happens if there are technical problems during the event?
4.answer: All our equipment includes complete backup gear. In the unlikely event that any technical issue arises, we have immediate solutions to ensure the show never stops. In exceptional circumstances completely beyond our control, we return 100% of the deposit and help you find a quality alternative.

5.question: Can I choose the music or do you decide?
5.answer: You decide the style and the key moments (entrance, first dance, toast...). Before the event we met to create a personalized playlist. During the event, the DJ combines your preferences with real-time ambient reading to maintain vibrant energy.

6.question: What exactly does each package include?
6.answer: Each pack includes professional DJ, sound equipment, lighting, assembly/disassembly and coordination. Higher packages add special effects, more hours, and advanced customization. In the configurator you can see exactly what each option includes.

7.question: How does the reservation process work?
7.answer: 1) Set up your event or request a quote. 2) We get in touch in less than 2 hours. 3) Meeting (in person or video call) to know your vision. 4) Closed budget without surprises. 5) Reservation with 30% deposit. 6) Coordination prior to the event. 7) Enjoy!

faqs.question: What exactly does the service include?
faqs.answer: Each pack includes: professional DJ, complete sound equipment, LED lighting, assembly and disassembly, transportation (free up to 25km from Granollers), and coordination with the venue. The most advanced packs include special effects, theming, and extra services.

faqs.question: What areas do you work in?
faqs.answer: We cover Barcelona and Girona (province). Free transport up to 25km from Granollers. For longer distances, we add a transportation supplement that we inform you in the quote.

faqs.question: How far in advance do I have to reserve?
faqs.answer: We recommend: 6-8 weeks for weekends, 3-4 weeks for weekdays. For complex themes (Harry Potter, Halloween), 2 months is better. But always ask us - sometimes we have last minute free dates!

faqs.question: Do you do events during the week?
faqs.answer: Yeah! From Monday to Thursday we have availability and often offer special prices. Ideal for corporate events or private parties.

faqs.question: Are the prices I see final?
faqs.answer: Yeah! We work with fixed prices and without surprises. The quote we give you is what you will pay. Includes everything: equipment, transportation, assembly, VAT... Everything.

faqs.question: How is the payment?
faqs.answer: Reserve with 30% to confirm the date. The remaining 70% is paid 7 days before the event. We accept transfer, Bizum, and card.

faqs.question: What happens if I have to cancel?
faqs.answer: We understand that sometimes things change. More than 60 days: 100% refund. 30-60 days: 50% refund. Less than 30 days: non-refundable. If you want to change the date (minimum 30 days in advance), we always try to accommodate!

faqs.question: Are there extra costs?
faqs.answer: Not if you tell us everything you need from the beginning. The only possible extras are: extra DJ hours (previously agreed upon price), extra travel (if you change location), or additional services that you add later.

faqs.question: What equipment do you carry?
faqs.answer: Own professional equipment: Pioneer DDJ-REV7 controller, EV ETX speakers (up to 4000W), 4 LED moving heads, multi-effects, smoke machine, and much more. Everything prepared for any space.

faqs.question: Does it work outdoors?
faqs.answer: Yeah! All our equipment is prepared for outdoors. We carry protection for rain and wind. The only thing we need is access to electricity (minimum 16A).

faqs.question: How much sound power do I need?
faqs.answer: We calculate it according to the space and the number of guests. For 100 people indoors, 2000W is enough. For 200+ or ​​outdoors, we carry 4000W. We always carry more than necessary for safety.

faqs.question: Can I choose the music?
faqs.answer: Of course! Before the event we hold a meeting to talk about your tastes, special songs (first dance, entrance, etc.), and what you DON'T want to hear. The DJ combines your preferences with the audience reading in real time.

faqs.question: What style of music do you make?
faqs.answer: Of everything! Pop, current hits, reggaeton, electronica, classics from the 80s-90s, rock, indie, Latin... We have a library of +15,000 songs and we always update with the latest news. If you ask us for something we don't have, we will download it.

faqs.question: Can I send a playlist?
faqs.answer: Yeah! You can send us a Spotify or YouTube playlist. The DJ will use it as a guide and will intersperse your songs with his own selection to maintain the energy.

faqs.question: Does the DJ speak on the microphone?
faqs.answer: Only if you want! Some clients want active animation (contests, advertisements...) and others prefer the music to speak for itself. You decide the style.

faqs.question: How does Harry Potter theming work?
faqs.answer: We transformed the space into Hogwarts: floating LED candles, tables for houses, potions station, complete decoration, and themed music. You can choose the level: from a subtle touch to total immersion. We are the only ones in Catalonia that offer this service professionally.

faqs.question: Do you do other themes apart from Halloween and Harry Potter?
faqs.answer: Yeah! We can create any theme: 80s, Tropical, Gatsby, Disco, Mafia, Cirque du Soleil... Tell us the idea and we will suggest how to make it a reality.

faqs.question: What happens if the venue already has decoration?
faqs.answer: Perfect! We adapt. We can add thematic elements that complement the existing decoration or work with your wedding planner to integrate everything.

faqs.question: Does the decoration stay up for the entire event?
faqs.answer: Yeah! We set up before the guests arrive and take down when the event is over. The decoration stays all night for photos and atmosphere.

faqs.question: How much time do you need to ride?
faqs.answer: It depends on the service: basic DJ = 1-1.5h, with full lighting = 2h, theming = 3-4h. We always coordinate with the venue so as not to disturb other preparations.

faqs.question: What do you need from the venue?
faqs.answer: Basically electricity (minimum 16A, ideally 32A for large setups) and a space to set up. We always contact the venue beforehand to confirm everything.

faqs.question: What happens if it rains?
faqs.answer: If the event is outside, we bring protections for the equipment. If necessary, we can move indoors quickly. We always have a plan B prepared.

faqs.question: What time do you have to arrive?
faqs.answer: We usually arrive 2-3 hours before start. For theming, it can be 4-5 hours. We agree with you and the venue.

faqs.question: Do you have insurance?
faqs.answer: Yeah! We have civil liability insurance that covers any incident during the event. You can ask us for the certificate if the venue requires it.

faqs.question: What if the DJ gets sick?
faqs.answer: We have a network of trusted DJs who know our style. If something happens, we will notify you immediately and look for the best solution. In 15 years, this has only happened 2 times and we have always found a replacement to match.

reserve.description: If you found an available date, don't wait. Contact us to lock it in.

1.question: How far in advance should I book?
1.answer: We recommend booking at least 2-3 months in advance, especially for weddings and important events. However, we also accept last-minute bookings if we have availability.

2.question: What if my date is already reserved?
2.answer: If the date you want is taken, we can suggest nearby alternative dates. You can also contact us to check possible cancellations or changes.

3.question: Is it updated in real time?
3.answer: The calendar is updated every 15 minutes. If you just made an inquiry and don't see your reservation yet, that's normal. You'll receive a confirmation email.
